source_name: ProCredit Bank АД Скопје (pcb.mk) — Менаџмент и Акционери
why_relevant: ProCredit's MK site publishes Management Board / Supervisory Board composition and a shareholders page; the ProCredit group rotates managers across countries, so this page is the reliable local roster. Note the live domain is pcb.mk, not procreditbank.com.mk.

source_name: УНИБанка АД Скопје — Новости и Редовно собрание
why_relevant: Unibank publishes news items (incl. interviews with management) and hosts AGM material under a '/content/Редовно собрание/<N> Редовна седница/' folder structure with per-agenda-item PDFs — an enumerable AGM archive.

source_name: ТТК Банка АД Скопје — Новости
why_relevant: Newsroom of a listed mid-size bank; carries share-issue notices, corporate notifications and operational announcements. Query-string driven .aspx site with an English variant (WebEn.aspx).

source_name: Централна кооперативна банка АД Скопје — За ЦКБ / документен репозиториум
why_relevant: Bulgarian-owned CCB Skopje publishes corporate documents under /ControlPanel/Upload/Sobranie<YYYY>/ and /Upload/Documents/ — i.e. AGM packs and reports are served as raw PDFs from predictable folders, even though there is no polished IR section.

source_name: Silk Road Bank АД Скопје — Медиа и Вработување (srb.mk / silkroadbank.com.mk)
why_relevant: Silk Road Bank runs two domains: the current brand site srb.mk (footer links 'Медиа' and 'Вработување') and the legacy silkroadbank.com.mk, whose news items are served as NewsDetails.php?News=<N>&lang=<mk|en> — a directly enumerable news archive.

source_name: Македонска берза (MSE) issuer pages for MK banks — статутарни соопштенија на издавачите
why_relevant: Pointer/mirror for the first-party disclosures in this cell: every listed bank (KMB, STB, UNI, TTK, CKB, SPARK, Halkbank as a new MSE member) files AGM convocations, decisions on board election and price-sensitive personnel announcements here. Useful as a completeness check when a bank's own site is slow to publish, and it also links each issuer's PDF filings (e.g. the KB 2023 audited statements under /Repository/Javni ponudi/).

source_name: LinkedIn company pages of MK banks (e.g. Silk Road Bank AD Skopje)
why_relevant: Banks in this cell maintain LinkedIn pages where appointments are announced and vacancies posted, sometimes before the corporate site updates; also reveals headcount trend and new function names. English-dominant, which complements the mk-only newsroom text.

source_name: Vrabotuvanje.com.mk — банкарски огласи и работодавачки профили
why_relevant: Largest MK job board; banks in this cell (confirmed for NLB Банка) run employer-branding content and vacancy listings here, giving a cross-bank comparable hiring feed that the individual careers pages do not.

source_name: Македонска берза — СЕИ-Нет вести RSS (сите објави од котирани друштва)
why_relevant: Machine-readable RSS feed of every SEI-NET disclosure by MSE-listed issuers, including banks. Item titles carry date + issuer + disclosure category (e.g. 'Промени во органите на управување и раководење', 'Трансакции со акции од лица во органи на управување и надзор', 'Други ценовно чувствителни информации') and link to the full document on seinet.com.mk. This is the fastest legally mandated leadership-change signal for listed MK banks.

source_name: СЕИНет (SEINet) — електронски систем за објави на котирани друштва
why_relevant: The authoritative document repository behind MSE disclosures; every material-event notice (resignations, appointments, statute changes) is filed here as a dated document with a stable numeric ID.

source_name: Македонска берза — вести на берзата (Објави од берзата) листа
why_relevant: Exchange-generated news listing, paginated to ~889 pages, covering exchange notices about issuers (listing decisions, suspensions, buy-backs) that often accompany or contextualise governance changes at listed banks.

source_name: МБ — RSS по издавач (пример: Комерцијална банка)
why_relevant: Per-issuer SEI-NET RSS lets you subscribe to exactly the seven listed banks rather than filtering the whole market, cutting noise to near zero for A5 leadership-move monitoring.

source_name: МБ — издавачи на задолжителна котација (список на котирани банки)
why_relevant: Canonical actor map for this cell: identifies exactly which banks carry SEI-NET disclosure obligations. Fetched listing shows 7 banks — Комерцијална банка (KMB), АЛТА банка АД Битола (ex-Стопанска банка Битола), ТТК Банка, НЛБ Банка, Стопанска банка АД Скопје, УНИ Банка, Централна кооперативна банка — each with an issuer page and website.

source_name: МБ — страница на издавач: НЛБ Банка АД Скопје
why_relevant: Issuer pages carry an 'Управа' (management) tab plus 'СЕИ-Нет вести' and 'Објави од берзата' sections — a per-bank governance snapshot that can be diffed over time to detect board changes even without a filing.

source_name: МБ — страница на издавач: Стопанска банка АД Скопје
why_relevant: Second-largest listed bank; same issuer-page structure with management tab and SEI-NET news stream.

source_name: МБ — страница на издавач: Централна кооперативна банка АД Скопје
why_relevant: Listed bank with convertible bonds outstanding; disclosure obligations extend to bondholder-relevant governance events.

source_name: МБ — архивски пример: Развојна Банка на Северна Македонија, 'Промени во органите на управување и раководење'
why_relevant: Confirms the exact announcement URL grammar (/mk/announcement/{d}/{m}/{yyyy}/{issuer}/{category-slug}) and the disclosure category slug 'Changes-in-management-bodies' — the highest-precision crawl key for this cell. Also shows that non-listed banks (Development Bank) disclose through the Free Market segment.

source_name: МБ — Правила за котација (обврски за објавување)
why_relevant: Defines the taxonomy of mandatory disclosure categories and the deadlines — needed to know which governance events must be filed, how fast, and what the exact category labels are that the RSS titles use.

source_name: МБ — Извештај за следење на усогласеноста на котираните друштва со Кодексот за корпоративно управување
why_relevant: Annual MSE compliance report on corporate-governance practice of listed companies — gives structural context (board composition norms, independence, committee structures) against which individual bank leadership moves can be read.

source_name: КХВ — Годишни извештаи (список на издадени согласности и решенија)
why_relevant: Because KHV does not publish a chronological decisions register on the web, the annual report is the practical archive: it enumerates consents/решенија granted during the year, including approvals of directors of brokerage houses and depository/market participants.

source_name: НБРСМ — Банкарска супервизија и регулатива (издавање согласности за лица со посебни права и одговорности)
why_relevant: CRITICAL SCOPE CORRECTION for this cell: prior approval of bank management-board and supervisory-board members in North Macedonia is granted by the NATIONAL BANK (НБРСМ), not by the Securities Commission. The NBRM 'Одлука за издавање согласности' sets the fit-and-proper consent regime; NBRM is therefore the true regulatory-approval counterpart to the MSE disclosure feed.

source_name: Кодекси за корпоративно управување на котираните банки (пример: ТТК Банка, УНИ Банка)
why_relevant: Bank-published governance codes are versioned and dated (TTK v. 30.06.2025; UNI Banka v.19, 31.01.2025). Version bumps are a low-noise proxy for statute/organisation changes, and the codes name the bodies and committees whose membership must be disclosed.

source_name: SEINet мобилна апликација (iOS / Android)
why_relevant: Official MSE mobile client for listed-company disclosures. Its existence implies a backing JSON/mobile API for SEINet that would be a cleaner, more stable ingestion path than scraping the SPA — worth reverse-engineering as a collection route.

source_name: Faktor.mk — деловни вести за промени во управните одбори на банките
why_relevant: Macedonian business media routinely re-report MSE/NBRM board decisions with named individuals and mandate dates, often adding the NBRM consent detail that the bare filing omits. Useful as a corroboration and name-normalisation layer, never as the primary record.

source_name: НБРСМ — Регистар на оператори на платните системи (Register of payment system operators)
why_relevant: Identifies the licensed operators of MK payment systems (KIBS clearing, CaSys card scheme/switch, NBRSM MIPS) — the core infrastructure employers in this cell.

source_name: НБРСМ — Издавање дозволи (licensing page for PI/EMI, contact licenciranjepups@nbrm.mk)
why_relevant: Explains and announces licensing decisions for payment institutions and EMIs; licence grants are the leading indicator of a new payments employer and of management approvals.
